text: At its meeting on November 25, 2024, the Service Excellence Committee considered Item SE6.1 and made recommendations to the Executive Committee. Summary from the report (November 4, 2024) Report from the Interim Executive Director, Customer Experience: The purpose of this report is to provide an update to the Service Excellence Committee on work undertaken by the Customer Experience Division since May 2024. This work supports requests from the Committee to report back on a prototype report ward dashboard and to consider whether additional features could be added (e.g., multi-year data, predictive trends, etc.), where feasible. The Customer Experience Division has been working on the concept of ward dashboards since March 2024.
